name: Knock-
text: Knock- is the anglicized spelling of the Irish word cnoc, which means a hill or a height. The prefix opens an immense number of Irish place-names. It also appears in many Scottish Gaelic place-names. The Welsh cousin of the word is cnwc. The two hills Knockfeerina and Knockaulin show the prefix at work.

key_results: Give the Irish source of the prefix.
